title: Filipino Soybean Sprouts Noodles
description: A traditional Filipino dish featuring soybean sprouts and noodles, often served as a solo dinner, this recipe is bitter, crumbly, and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the soybean sprouts and cook, stirring occasionally, until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the cooked rice noodles, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Cook for another 2 minutes, until the noodles are well coated with the sprout mixture.
Taste and adjust the seasoning, adding patis if using.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped green onions if desired.
Knead the noodles with the sprout mixture to combine thoroughly.
Let it rest for a few minutes before serving.
